paper_title: Subgraph Counting in Subquadratic Time for Bounded Degeneracy Graphs
statement: ▶ Conjecture 1.8. For any ε > 0, there is no O(m2−ε )-time algorithm for computing SubH△ (G).
context: The approach of subdividing edges can be used to prove a relation between other patterns too. In the case of hypergraphs, we can replace hyperedges of arity r by r-stars. We are able to show a strong relation between the hypergraph H△ depicted in Fig. 4, and a 10-vertex pattern. We conjecture that for this pattern we can not count the number of subgraphs in subquadratic time. ▶ Conjecture 1.8. For any ε > 0, there is no O(m2−ε )-time algorithm for computing SubH△ (G). This conjecture implies that there are no subquadratic algorithms for computing the number of subgraphs of all 10-vertex patterns. ▶ Lemma 1.9. If Conjecture 1.8 holds, then for any ε > 0 there is no algorithm that computes SubH (G) in time f (κ)O(n2−ε ) for all patterns H with 10 vertices.
